infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AEGISDRIVE uses your location to protect your vehicle and dispatch help to you during an incident.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: AEGISDRIVE tracks your route in the background so protection continues when your screen is off. Without this, a hijacking cannot be located.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used for the voice duress trigger and to capture audio evidence during an active incident.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera captures evidence during an incident and when you attach it to a report.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion data powers the covert shake activation, so you can raise an alarm without looking at your phone.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID unlocks the app without exposing your credentials on screen.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: AEGISDRIVE tracks your route in the background so protection continues when your screen is off.

plugins.cameraPermission: AEGISDRIVE captures evidence during an incident.
plugins.microphonePermission: AEGISDRIVE records audio evidence and listens for your duress phrase.
